answer.reason: The verses tell of his work on the sanctuary beside Bezaleel and of the wisdom he was given for it, which adds to the summary.

clauses.english: was filled with wisdom of heart to teach and to do all manner of skilled work
clauses.quote: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart

clauses.english: worked with Bezaleel on the sanctuary as the LORD had commanded
clauses.quote: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man

doubts: EXO 38:19 is marked but describes the pillars of the court and does not name him, so it was left out.
